headline: GTA VI makes 3.79 billion dollars on its first day, the biggest entertainment launch in history
label: VIRAL
caption:
Grand Theft Auto VI just broke every entertainment record. 🎮

Rockstar Games and its parent company Take Two Interactive say GTA VI made 3.79 billion dollars in worldwide retail sales on launch day, November 19.

The game also sold 32.5 million copies before it was even released, which Take Two calls a new record across all platforms.

That first day is roughly four times bigger than GTA V, which made more than 800 million dollars on its first day in 2013.

GTA VI is out now on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X and S, after two delays and more than a decade of development.
